metadata.title: Internex — The Future of Internship Discovery
metadata.description: A centralized platform bridging the gap between universities and enterprises. Skill-based matching, automated document generation, and placement tracking.

hero.headline: The Future of Internship Discovery
hero.description1: A centralized platform bridging the gap between universities and enterprises. Skill-based matching, automated document generation, and placement tracking—all in one elegant system.
hero.description2: Within the framework of MESRS strategy to strengthen the University-Enterprise link, Internex digitizes the entire internship lifecycle from discovery to official Convention de Stage.

studentSpace.desc: Build your profile, tag skills, connect GitHub. Search and apply with smart filters.

companyPortal.desc: Publish offers, track candidates, accept talent. One click triggers the full workflow.

adminDashboard.desc: Validate placements, generate official PDFs, access global placement analytics.

howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.headline: Streamlined Workflow for Everyone
howItWorks.description: Whether you're a student seeking opportunities, a company looking for talent, or an administrator managing placements—Internex provides a seamless experience tailored to your role.

register.title: Create Your Account
register.description: Register with your university email and verify your student status securely.

profile.title: Build Your Digital CV
profile.description: Add your skills, experience, and connect your GitHub or portfolio links.

search.title: Discover Opportunities
search.description: Use smart filters to find internships by location, tech stack, or company type.

apply.title: Apply with One Click
apply.description: Send your profile directly to companies and track your applications.

profile.title: Company Profile
profile.description: Set up your company page with logo, description, and office locations.

offers.title: Publish Offers
offers.description: Create, modify, and manage internship positions with detailed requirements.

candidates.title: Review Candidates
candidates.description: Access a dashboard of applicants and filter by skills or experience.

accept.title: Accept & Proceed
accept.description: Accept candidates and trigger the administrative workflow automatically.

validate.title: Validate Placements
validate.description: Review and approve internship matchings submitted by companies.

documents.title: Generate Documents
documents.description: Auto-generate Convention de Stage PDFs with all required data pre-filled.

statistics.title: Track Statistics
statistics.description: Access global analytics on placement rates and student outcomes.
